item.title: Show HN: Inplan – Before Start Coding
item.summary: Hi HN! I'm one of the makers of inplan, which is a tool to anchor comments to design docs to allow deep/focused design specification. We've improved the product - now it supports more features like linking images and constructing multiple documents for complex projects. Please give it a try and share feedback!
